title: One Finance UX inbound business event (v1)
description: The versioned contract every source system publishes to POST /api/events. Enforced at the gateway. sourceSystem is an open, Admin-extensible pattern (not a closed enum) so registering a new producer is configuration, not a schema change. Platform-internal workflow events (sourceSystem ONEFINUX) are generated by the hub and are not subject to this gateway contract.

eventId.description: Producer-assigned unique id. Re-sending the same id is a no-op (idempotent). If omitted/null the hub derives a deterministic id.

eventType.description: Governed catalogue name, e.g. MASTERBOOK_READY, SAP_TB_COMPLETE, HELIX_ANALYSIS_COMPLETE.

sourceSystem.description: Registered publishing system. Open pattern: Admin registers new systems without a schema change.

sourceKey.description: The source's own identifier (book, cost centre, batch, feed, schedule, run or report id).

cobDate.description: Close-of-business date the event belongs to.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened at source (UTC). Defaults to receipt time.

attributes.description: Optional context. Completions that produced an artifact should echo correlationId and runId.
